personalInfo.name: Linden Hutchinson
personalInfo.title: Software Engineer, Backend & AI
personalInfo.description: Software engineer with 7+ years building production systems and AI products.

experience.description: Engineer at a VC-backed startup building a screen-aware voice AI assistant that guides users through product onboarding and activation. Stack: FastAPI, Firebase, and Svelte.
achievements: Designed and delivered an enterprise onboarding feature that books employees into sessions on their own calendars, built to onboard rosters of 10,000+ without manual scheduling.
Solely built an MCP server with OAuth 2.1, giving stakeholders secure access to product data from AI assistants.
Created a customer-facing AI analyst that answers questions about call data with cited evidence, replacing manual reporting across 10,000+ queries.
Developed a post-call analysis pipeline that shows customers where users get stuck and why, and turns those insights directly into improvements.

experience.description: Full-stack engineer on a marketplace platform and GraphQL API, focused on feature work, backend performance, and observability.
achievements: Cut execution time of a key SQL query by 96% through query and index optimisation.
Owned features end to end across the API and web apps, working with stakeholders from requirements through release.
Ran security audits that found and fixed SQL injection and XSS vulnerabilities, protecting user data.
Improved monitoring and test coverage, so performance problems were caught earlier and releases shipped with more confidence.

experience.description: Senior engineer building high-security Python products for Australian Government clients and internal SaaS tools.
achievements: Co-authored a report on the commercial viability of open-source LLMs, leading the evaluation that benchmarked capability across model families and sizes.
Architected a greenfield internal application integrating multiple APIs, built to meet high-security requirements.
Resolved an issue in a legacy application that had persisted for 6 months, saving the team 30 minutes of manual work per day.
Led code reviews and mentored developers on security and coding standards.

experience.description: Modernised legacy PHP systems and built custom full-stack applications for enterprise clients.
achievements: Stabilised a legacy system by tracing and fixing long-standing reliability issues.
Built a bespoke platform that took a meat-judging competition off paper, letting organisers upload contestants and judges enter scores online, with results calculated automatically.
Built customisable dashboards that let council staff see the state of sewerage and water treatment indicators at a glance.
Optimised SQL queries over multi-million-row datasets, keeping the application responsive as data grew.

projects.title: Real-Time Multiplayer Game
projects.description: A real-time multiplayer social deduction game with a typed Python API and low-latency WebSocket communication, deployed with Docker on a DigitalOcean droplet.

projects.title: Self-Hosted AI Agent
projects.description: An AI agent that runs a home media server. It recommends titles through chat, monitors every service and summarises what's happening in plain language, and fixes stalled downloads on its own within a set of safe tool calls.
